notes: Plan 7 Track N, written by Claude (our own names and words). The bosses of the dungeon climaxes (data/claude/dungeons-1.json, dungeons-2.json; CR = the dungeon's CR) and of the Crisis key sites (villains.json: each act's boss, the finale villains, and the recurring Drake-Speaker once per act; CR = the act's keyCr), plus two drakes of the Drake-Speaker's. A boss is fought as `boss` in a fight (twice its role's HP, harder to stagger, acting twice when bloodied) and has a signature move (`when: desperate`: it replaces the bloodied boss's second action) and a second trick. The engine does not play boss moves yet (Track I or a follow-up: one hook that turns a move into an intent); each move's `todo` names anything more it needs. Their henchmen are SRD creatures in data/imported/creatures.json. `roads: false` keeps them off the road slots.

entries.name: the Cutpurse Captain
